versions.changelog:
yunlv-pod-templates 1.0.1

- Updated skill description for clarity: now emphasizes copywriting guides and design keyword templates for POD (Print on Demand).
- Adjusted triggers and tags to include "POD文案指南" and related terms, improving discoverability for copywriting and template needs.
- Clarified API usage and description in metadata for greater transparency.
- No changes to template content, features, pricing, or core workflow.

yunlv-pod-templates 1.0.0 – initial release:

- Provides ready-to-use POD (Print On Demand) design keywords, title templates, and listing copy for TikTok, Etsy, Amazon, and Shopify.
- Includes AI design keywords, fill-in title templates, platform-ready five-point and short descriptions, and quick pricing calculators.
- Covers 10 major product categories (e.g., retro, pets, family, holidays, fitness, etc.).
- Designed for quick SKU launches: copy templates, replace keywords, and reduce listing time.
- Emphasizes copyright safety, platform adaptation tips, and clear data privacy/compliance practices.
- Offers both standard templates and a path for custom requests based on user platform, audience, and product.
